name: sql_clause_keyword
description: Fill the SQL clause keyword for source tables, filtering, grouping, or ordering from a partial SQL query.
generator_code:
import random,json
random.seed(0)
items=[];control=[]
for i in range(100):
 table=random.choice(['users','orders','products','events','books']);field=random.choice(['id','price','age','score']);typ=i%4
 templates=[(f'SELECT {field} ___ {table};','FROM'),(f'SELECT * FROM {table} ___ {field} > 10;','WHERE'),(f'SELECT {field}, COUNT(*) FROM {table} ___ BY {field};','GROUP'),(f'SELECT * FROM {table} ___ BY {field};','ORDER')]
 q,answer=templates[typ];p=f'SQL query: {q}\n'
 items.append({'prompt':p+'Replace ___ with one uppercase SQL keyword. Keyword:', 'answer':' '+answer})
 control.append({'prompt':p+'What is the table name? Table:', 'answer':' '+table})
json.dump({'items':items,'control':control},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
